description: React component for a channel move submenu in Mattermost, allowing users to move channels between categories or create new categories.

methods.name: handleMoveToCategory
methods.description: Handles moving a channel to a selected category by dispatching an action.

methods.name: handleMoveToNewCategory
methods.description: Opens a modal to create a new category and add channels to it.

methods.name: createSubmenuItemsForCategoryArray
methods.description: Creates menu items for each category, including special labels and selection indicators.

methods.name: filterCategoriesBasedOnChannelType
methods.description: Filters categories based on whether channels are direct messages or GMs.

methods.name: getMoveToCategorySubmenuItems
methods.description: Determines which categories to show in the submenu based on channel type and selection context.
